slots.label: Credit card affiliate network
slots.note: Verified 2026-10-07: no single network covers all 9 cards. FlexOffers lists Amex, Capital One, Discover card programs; CJ Affiliate lists Chase, Citi, Wells Fargo (and Discover). Apply to one or both as a new publisher — approval is case-by-case and finance content faces compliance review. Confirm exact payout per offer inside the network before promoting (published payout ranges disagree). Paste your sub-ID to activate card links site-wide.
